name: Savvy
summary: Savvy is a groundbreaking mobile app positioned at the intersection of gaming and livestreaming, offering an innovative entertainment experience that redefines how streamers and their fans connect, compete, and collaborate. Our mission is to create an entirely novel category of interactive mobile entertainment that replaces passive viewing with active participation and turns both content creators and consumers into contestants.
